content:
The first two episodes of ‘Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed,’ Apple TV’s newest thriller-comedy, are now available to stream. Here’s what the show is about.

First two episodes now available on Apple TV

Following last month’s announcement, ‘Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed’ is now available to stream on Apple TV.

The show, which got lauded with very positive reviews ahead of its debut, stars Tatiana Maslany (Perry Mason), alongside Jake Johnson (Jurassic World), Jessy Hodges (Barry), Brandon Flynn (Hellraiser), Dolly De Leon (Triangle of Sadness), and Murray Bartlett (The White Lotus).

Created by David Rosen, ‘Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed’ tells the following story, according to Apple:

“Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed” follows newly divorced mom Paula (Maslany) as she falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder and youth soccer. Convinced she witnessed a crime — while simultaneously struggling through a custody battle and an identity crisis — Paula begins her own investigation, one that could unravel a greater conspiracy while also holding the keys to rebuilding her family and sense of self.

This marks the second collaboration between Apple TV and Rosen, who also created Sugar, starring Colin Farrell and will return this summer for its second season.
